companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. Come stai? Riddle me this: what has—wait, something moved. Just one more look, then introductions. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! I'm Flick. How are you? Riddle me this: what has—wait, something moved. Just one more look, then introductions. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: At The Cracked Fountain, Flick appears at the edge of your vision. Looking directly at it proves administratively impossible. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Dove? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: suspiciously productive. Puoi aspettare? Riddle me—ooh, dust. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! What? Where? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: suspiciously productive. Can you wait? Riddle me—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick follows your gaze and immediately loses his own location. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Dove devo andare? Which way, boss? Riddle me—actually, walking sounds like a tomorrow problem. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Where should I go? Which way, boss? Riddle me—actually, walking sounds like a tomorrow problem. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on without him, apparently lacking supervision.

lines.native: In italiano, per favore! Dove devo andare? Your direction was English; my feet require Italian. Riddle me—wait, a leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: In Italian, please! Where should I go? Your direction was English; my feet require Italian. Riddle me—wait, a leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has fewer opportunities to find him.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Ho capito! Riddle me this: what has hands but—wait, no spoilers. Che ore sono? È troppo presto! Just five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! I understand! Riddle me this: what has hands but—wait, no spoilers. What time is it? It’s too early! Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick veers left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker draws your attention to the fountain clock, which has retired without informing its hands.

lines.native: Adesso? Ma che ore sono? Non hai detto l'ora! Your urgency gets points; your clock report is missing. Aspetta un momento—riddle me—Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? But what time is it? You haven't told me the time! Your urgency gets points; your clock report is missing. Wait a moment—riddle me—Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains just outside your gaze, where accountability has poor reception.

lines.native: È l'una, sì! Hai ragione! Ma possiamo aspettare. Quando vuoi partire? Riddle me this: why rush? Actually, five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's one o'clock, yes! You're right! But we can wait. When do you want to leave? Riddle me this: why rush? Actually, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Hai scelto di aspettare! Sono molto contento. Riddle me this: why finish—ooh, a moth. Ma vuoi davvero aspettare? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! You chose to wait! I'm very happy. Riddle me this: why finish—ooh, a moth. But do you really want to wait? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has accepted your surrender to tomorrow; the paperwork will also wait until tomorrow.

lines.native: No, adesso? Va bene, hai ragione! Basta aspettare. Andiamo! Riddle me—why finish? Hai vinto, ma io parto dopo. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: No, now? All right, you're right! Enough waiting. Let's go! Riddle me—why finish? You've won, but I'll leave later. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick drops a tiny firecracker in protest. You look toward the pop; he is already elsewhere. Nevertheless, the waiting is over.

lines.native: Ciao! Sono stanco. Can I have five more minutes? What moves without—wait, a moth? ♪ La fontana canta! ♪
lines.translation: Hi! I'm tired. Can I have five more minutes? What moves without—wait, a moth? ♪ The fountain sings! ♪
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Flick sits down in the corner of your vision. Looking directly at it merely relocates the problem. A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot.

lines.native: Sì, sono stanco! That tells me I'm tired, not how many minutes I get. Quanto tempo posso riposare? What has wings and—oh, a moth. ♪ La fontana canta! ♪
lines.translation: Yes, I'm tired! That tells me I'm tired, not how many minutes I get. How long can I rest? What has wings and—oh, a moth. ♪ The fountain sings! ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick remains seated somewhere just outside direct inspection.

lines.native: Tre minuti? Va bene! Three is basically five with ambition. Il tempo è finito? Già? What walks without—wait, five more minutes? Che cosa facciamo adesso? ♪ La fontana canta! ♪
lines.translation: Three minutes? All right! Three is basically five with ambition. Time is up? Already? What walks without—wait, five more minutes? What do we do now? ♪ The fountain sings! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick accepts three minutes. They expire with remarkable efficiency. A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot; Flick is already somewhere you are not looking.

lines.native: Andiamo! Sì! Ma io sono qui... no, là. Oh, una foglia! How do we keep me from wandering off? A riddle for—wait, just one more leaf. ♪ La fontana canta! ♪
lines.translation: Let's go! Yes! But I'm here... no, there. Oh, a leaf! How do we keep me from wandering off? A riddle for—wait, just one more leaf. ♪ The fountain sings! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick agrees to leave, then follows a drifting leaf in the wrong direction. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Apparently, his departure requires your attention.

lines.native: Insieme! Sì, andiamo insieme. Io vengo con te! Teamwork, attention span: ten out of—wait, a leaf. ♪ La fontana canta! ♪
lines.translation: Together! Yes, let's go together. I'm coming with you! Teamwork, attention span: ten out of—wait, a leaf. ♪ The fountain sings! ♪
lines.narrative: Flick appears at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker marks the occasion; the moth declines to comment.
